title: 安田記念の後に・渾身のビヨンド

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Through this race, I learn that I barely have enough stamina to finish running a single mile. It seems sprints are my better bet.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I can feel it in my very bones. If I run in the 1,300-meter Prix Maurice de Gheest, I'll be sure to claim my very first European G1 victory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I can't simply run away from racing against Taiki. No, I must go against my destiny in order to surpass it in the future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I hereby renounce the Prix Maurice de Gheest!
